status_effects.explanation: The narrator is momentarily admitted into an eminent adult's courteous, attentive treatment, an inclusion unusual for someone his age, though the gesture may be diplomatic performance rather than genuine personal regard.

appraisal_events.evidence: inclinant la tête de mon côté avec courtoisie... il attachait à tout ce qui tenait à lui une véritable importance, et même aux questions d'un garçon de mon âge qui n'était pas habitué à se voir montrer tant de politesse par des personnes du sien
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois addresses the narrator's timid question with unusual courtesy and treats it as consequential, briefly admitting the boy into serious adult attention atypical for his age, though the narrator himself frames this as possibly motivated by deference to his father rather than genuine interest.
